We compiled a novel abdominal skin dataset and adapted three deep learning models to segment abdominal skin pixels.

we developed a novel dataset of abdominal images with skin pixels annotated and used it for training deep learning models to segment abdominal skin in real time, with a mean cross validation accuracy 95.51%, which is significantly higher than the accuracy of other state of the art techniques.

1) the novel abdominal dataset we compiled and released can be used as a benchmark for abdominal skin segmentation research, 2) the U Net network is a promising deep learning based abdominal skin segmentation model, 3) the U Net model can segment abdominal skin with high accuracy, and 4) the model is computationally efficient and can be used for real time applications.

the development of an abdominal skin segmentation model that can be used in a wide variety applications, such as robotic surgeries, abdominal ultrasound and other medical procedures.
the development of a robust abdominal skin segmentation technique that can be used for abdominal robotic procedures, and the development of a novel abdominal dataset for the same.
the adaptation of deep learning techniques for skin segmentation, specifically in abdominal region, and the evaluation of these techniques on the novel Abdominal dataset.
